name: date-picker

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows the field resolved to a concrete date; the other frames show only placeholder or half-typed text.

tagline: Type "next friday" and it becomes a real dated calendar entry.
summary: A dark input that understands plain-language dates and resolves them to a calendar date. A calendar button is there for picking a day visually; no time is asked for.
appearance: A wide, thin dark bar with rounded corners and a light grey border. A small square calendar icon button sits at the left, followed by grey placeholder text across a long input.
behaviour: Typing a phrase like "next friday" and pressing Enter or clicking away replaces it with a formatted date. The border lightens while the field has focus. The calendar button opens a day-picker popover, though the clip never shows it.
demo_content: Placeholder reading "Enter a date and time"
search_phrases: choose a day without a time
enter a date phrase in a form
pick a publish date for a post
date field that reads next friday
use_when: A form needs one calendar date and you want typing a phrase to work as well.
avoid_when: Placeholder still says date and time although the time picker is switched off here.
customise: No props: the placeholder text, calendar-only mode and width are set in the file and need a source edit.
weight_why: A single input plus a calendar library; idle until opened.

a11y.note: The input has a placeholder but no linked label; the calendar button's text is screen-reader only.

issues: The calendar popover is never shown, so the picker panel itself is unverified.
Placeholder still promises a time even though this version hides the time picker.
polish_why: Standard dark field styling; no frame shows the calendar it is named for.
title: Date Picker
